content: Integrate the attached startup job hunter into ReachFlow as a guided software-engineer sprint.
Reuse ReachFlow search, profile, applications, and draft APIs instead of adding a second job database.
The attached MVP is approval-first and explicitly avoids scraping, auto-DMs, and automatic submissions.
Persist sprint settings inside the existing candidate_profile JSONB so no second job database is required.
Verify search-save-prepare-generate-status flow with project tests, typecheck, build, and a local smoke run.
Tests, typecheck, and production build pass; local page smoke test shows graceful sign-in state.
Authenticated Supabase search and application submission were not exercised because no signed-in session was provided.
